about: Live links read by js/listen.js on every visit. Fix a dead link here and every copy of the site and the app picks it up without an update. tv[].youtube.video is the official channel's live video, refreshed daily by tools/refresh_live.mjs; tv[].urls are the lower-quality HLS fallback. Checked daily by .github/workflows/sources.yml.
